subject: Re: Pelican Health — commitment sprint, legal timelines & procurement steps
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@pelicanhealth.com>
Cc: Marina Su <marina.su@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Pelican onboarding: proposed commitment sprint & evaluation checkpoints

Sam — great speaking today. Per our call, I put together a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that keeps your procurement and security teams moving while the engineering eval runs. High level: 

- 2-week technical eval (test VM + 25k tokens/day) starting Nov 1st
- Private Offer (AWS) to be submitted by Nov 5th, with billing path directed to Pelican’s AWS account (acct ending -9843)
- Legal review window: Nov 6th–13th (we’ll turn around initial redlines within 48 hours)
- Go/no-go decision target: Nov 16th (signing via DocuSign)

I attached a simple spreadsheet with milestones, owners, and deliverables (MAP v2). Can you confirm: 1) procurement contact for the PO (email), 2) whether Pelican needs a SOC 2 excerpt or full evidence bundle for the eval?

Thanks — I’ll loop in Soojin and Laura for pricing & billing paths.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0196
From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@pelicanhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pelican onboarding: proposed commitment sprint & evaluation checkpoints

Diego — thanks for the clear plan. A few clarifications from procurement & security before we confirm dates: 

1) Procurement: please send the proposed Private Offer template and the billing instructions for the AWS private offer (we bill through our central finance AWS account). Procurement contact is procure@pelicanhealth.com (cc’d on this thread).
2) Security: we need a SOC 2 excerpt and network/egress policy for the eval (not the full bundle yet) — is that something Redwood can provide by Oct 20?
3) Pricing: this is primarily an evaluation for a clinical NLP feature; can you provide the committed pricing for the 2-week eval and the month-1 post-signing consumption estimate?

If those items look OK we’ll try to keep to the Nov 1 start. 

Sam
Sam Jenkins | Director, Product — Pelican Health
sam.jenkins@pelicanhealth.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-13T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pelican onboarding: proposed commitment sprint & evaluation checkpoints

FYI — forwarding Sam’s note. Key asks we need to meet: Private Offer template + billing wiring directions for AWS, SOC2 excerpt by Oct 20, and committed pricing for the 2-week eval + month-1 post-signing consumption estimate.

Can one of you: 
- Soojin: please prepare the Private Offer draft (AWS PO) with billing alias to Pelican (acct -9843). Include 30-day net payment terms and the standard minimum committed spend language for a 3-month step-down (we discussed similar for Helix).
- Laura: can you draft the SOC2 excerpt and the network egress diagram that Pelican’s security team asked for? If you can get a short packet to me by Oct 19 I’ll pass it on.

I’m copying the procurement email per Sam to make it easier for them to confirm. I’ll also draft pricing below to speed things up: 

- Eval window: 2 weeks (25k tokens/day): waived platform fee, token rate $0.0008/token (Redwood hosted) — estimated $280 per week in consumed tokens, ~$560 total.
- Month-1 (post-sign): projected consumption 1.2M tokens — suggested committed discount tier at 10% off list for first 90 days under the private offer.

Ping me if anything blocks — want to keep the Nov 1 start date.

— Diego

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@pelicanhealth.com>, procure@pelicanhealth.com
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marina Su <marina.su@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final MAP + Private Offer (next steps + DocuSign)

Sam / Pelican procurement — thanks for your patience. Attached are the finalized artifacts you requested: 

- Pelican_MAP_v3.xlsx (milestones, owners, dates) — highlights: Nov 1 start for eval, Nov 5 private-offer submission, Nov 13 initial redlines completed, Nov 16 sign target.
- PrivateOffer_Redwood_v1.pdf — AWS Private Offer draft with billing path to Pelican AWS acct ending -9843 and payment terms Net 30.
- SOC2_evidence_index.txt — condensed SOC 2 excerpt and index to the full evidence bundle (we’ll provide the full package under an NDA if required).

Summary of next steps: 
1) Procurement: please confirm PO contact and if the PO will be issued before or after DocuSign (we generally accept PO + DocuSign signature).
2) Legal: we will accept initial redlines in DocuSign comments; expect a 48–72 hour turnaround on standard redlines.
3) Technical: we will provision a sandbox and credentials on Nov 1 (engineering contact: tim.eval@redwood.ai).

DocuSign link to execute the private offer: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&PowerFormId=abcd-1234-efgh-5678

Please reply with a firm PO contact and whether Pelican is able to sign by Nov 16. Happy to hop on a 15-min call to clear outstanding questions — propose Nov 17 at 10am PT if needed.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Pelican running.

— Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Pelican_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), PrivateOffer_Redwood_v1.pdf (PDF), SOC2_evidence_index.txt (text)
